text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace arrives at the summer 
training camp ahead of the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That rival was also taking part in summer 
training camp. She shares the same goal of 
defeating Mr. C.B. and hails from a 
distinguished lineage—Shiina Frejus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Determined that she had to become 
stronger, Shina Frejus tackled the summer 
training camp with an extraordinary 
intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace fires herself up, determined 
not to fall behind. And so, their 
respective summer training camps begin!
